item.title: What to know about the partial government shutdown and its impact
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The partial government shutdown that started Saturday is vastly different from the record closure in the fall. item.title: Woman accused of stealing $100K meant for sick pets in St. Louis
item.description: A woman accused of stealing more than $100,000 in donations meant to help sick pets in the St. Louis region and using the money for personal expenses is now behind bars.

item.title: Meramec River Resort in Missouri hits market for $2.1 million
item.description: A massive Missouri resort along the Meramec River has hit the market, offering a summertime retreat with cabins, campgrounds, river recreation and more than a century of rich history.
